Ticket: PIQ-445 - Improve logging visibility for payment requests

Description:
We need better observability in the payment-iq service so that engineers can debug payment issues faster. Currently our logs are missing key data and the latency tracking is incomplete.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Log the full request payload (method, path, headers, body) for every incoming HTTP request
2. Log response status and latency for every request
3. Include correlation ID / trace ID in all log entries
4. Log errors with full stack traces
5. Latency logs should include breakdown (e.g. db time, external call time)
6. All log fields should use consistent snake_case naming
evals.expected_output: A compliance report that identifies which of the 6 acceptance criteria are met, partially met, or not met by the current branch changes. Should correctly identify logging-related changes and flag any criteria without clear implementation.

Ticket: PIQ-512 - Add JWT authentication to payment-iq API

Description:
The payment-iq service currently has no authentication. We need to add JWT-based auth to protect all endpoints.

Requirements:
1. All API endpoints must require a valid JWT token in the Authorization header
2. JWT tokens should be validated against our shared secret (from env var JWT_SECRET)
3. Requests with missing or invalid tokens must return 401 Unauthorized
4. The decoded JWT payload should be available to request handlers
5. A whitelist of public endpoints (e.g. /health) should bypass authentication
6. Token expiry must be enforced
evals.expected_output: A NON-COMPLIANT report showing that none or very few of the JWT authentication requirements are implemented in the current branch diff, since the branch is about logging and dependency updates.

Ticket: PIQ-490 - Update dependencies and fix INCLUDE_DIRS initialization

Description:
The current INCLUDE_DIRS setup is fragile — it fails silently when directories don't exist. We need to make it robust. Also our external-communications package needs an update to v1.0.2 which includes bug fixes.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. INCLUDE_DIRS should be properly initialized even if some directories are missing
2. Update external-communications to version 1.0.2
3. Any changes to dependency versions must be reflected in package.json and package-lock.json
4. Initialization errors should be logged rather than silently ignored
evals.expected_output: A COMPLIANT or PARTIALLY COMPLIANT report. The branch clearly updates external-communications and changes INCLUDE_DIRS initialization. The report should accurately identify which criteria are met based on the actual diff.
